title: Unsent Marker
summary: Brings a typed-but-never-sent message back as a clear "Not sent" bubble, so people don't think they replied.
description: Left-behind draft shown as a dashed "Not sent · Priya hasn't received it" bubble in the thread where the reply would be, with Send, Edit and a two-tap Discard, plus a "Not sent:" preview for conversation lists.
catches: Text left in the composer and never sent
limits: Drafts are kept where your useUnsentDraft storage keeps them (per device)
Doesn't know about sends from other devices unless you clear the draft
a11y: Bubble is a labelled group including the text
Buttons have text labels; icons are aria-hidden
stops: Thought I replied but never sent it
